notes.title: Secret Shuffle is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
TL;DR: The Steam version of Secret Shuffle is out now, unlocking all games and music for all players and showing everyone (including spectators!) what's going on in the game!

[h3]What is this?![/h3]
Secret Shuffle is a party game for 4 or more players wearing headphones. We came up with 10 hilarious game modes using this setup and everyone's favorite is usually 'Fakers'. In Fakers, everyone dances to the same music, except for one person (the Faker) who doesn't hear anything but pretending to hear music, while everyone else needs to guess who that person is. Anyway; this is just one of the games! More info about what's in Secret Shuffle in the game's description.

[h3]What is going on?![/h3]
Secret Shuffle is a game that happens in real life, not bound to any platform. Sure, you need the mobile app with headphones connected to your phone to actually run the game... but the experience happens between its players, in their looks at each other, and in dancing with each other. But as a spectator who doesn't hear any instructions or music, what is going on is hard to understand. Heck, even as a player it can be a little confusing at times!

[h3]Introducing: Secret Shuffle's Big Screen[/h3]
With this Steam release, we are giving you the option to put Secret Shuffle up on a big screen and show everyone – players and spectators alike – what is going on. Whether the screen becomes the center of attention or a backdrop to a lively game, the Steam version of Secret Shuffle ties together the experience for all player and spectators, as well as unlocking all the games and music packs that Secret Shuffle has to offer.

The team and I worked on and off on Secret Shuffle for 8 years, and we are very proud of the experience we have created. Especially with Fakers, the social deduction 'find the imposter'-kind of game, I think we've struck gold. We hope you'll enjoy Secret Shuffle as much as we enjoying playing the game at the hundreds of playtests we did to improve the game! 

Try Secret Shuffle at your next party / hangout with friends / team event / lunch break / get together!

[h3]Secret Shuffle was made by...[/h3]
Adriaan de Jongh - Game Designer & Programmer
Sim Kaart - Graphic Designer
Yero Pharaoh - Music Curator & Sound Designer
Gilles van Leeuwen - Film Maker & Editor
Sandy Seifert - Creative Producer
... and various freelance collaborators. Check the ingame credits for the full overview!
